name: live-layer-protocol
description: Live Layer Protocol: stream signed WebAssembly layers into a running app, no CI/CD

scripts.test: node test/run.mjs && node test/service.mjs && node test/live-e2e.mjs && node test/ai-loop.mjs && node test/fleet.mjs
scripts.build: asc layers/tasks-as/app.ts -o build/tasks.wasm -O3 && clang --target=wasm32 -nostdlib -O2 -Wl,--no-entry -o build/stats.wasm layers/stats-c/stats.c && asc layers/variants/tasks_v2.ts -o build/tasks_v2.wasm -O3 && asc layers/variants/tasks_broken.ts -o build/tasks_broken.wasm -O3 && asc layers/variants/tasks_trap.ts -o build/tasks_trap.wasm -O3
